text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ

words.gloss_range: vocative particle that turns the parable into addressed speech before any claim is stated
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens with direct address rather than detached explanation. It catches the audience before the parable is announced, and its long opening sound lets the later command {{ar:ٱسْتَمِعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istamiʿū}}) arrive as the required response to a summons already underway.

topics.headline: direct summons before proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the parable begins as a public summons, so the later listening command answers an address already in force.
topics.reason: QAC marks a vocative particle, and the CRITICAL rows consistently connect it to the following listening imperative and public announcement frame.

words.gloss_range: vocative mediator that licenses the definite class noun as the addressee
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ʾayyuhā}}) is the visible fused bridge between {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) and {{ar:ٱلنَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nāsu}}). It delays the named addressee just long enough to compress mediation into one word and make the address formal and class-wide, not a call to a private or named individual.

topics.headline: mediated universal address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the call widen through a grammatical bridge before the audience is named.
topics.reason: The word is parsed as the vocative mediator before the definite class noun, matching the CRITICAL rows on mediation and universalization.

words.gloss_range: definite human collective as the named addressee of the parable
words.root_gloss_range: sociality, familiarity, perception, and the contested forgetfulness background; local syntax selects the recognized human class addressed for listening
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nāsu}}) fixes the open vocative as the recognized human class. The root background can suggest social recognition and perception, while the local construction narrows the payoff to a public audience made responsible for deliberate hearing. The same address formula links this moment with 22:1 and 22:5, so the fly-parable re-summons the surah-wide human audience. Its nasal close also gives the opening audience-label a firm audible landing before the parable is struck.

topics.headline: human class under listening duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity as a recognized public class is made responsible for hearing the proof.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar gives a definite nominative apposition to the vocative mediator; the broader root and same-surah rows survive as public-audience pressure, not as a replacement for the local noun sense.

words.gloss_range: perfect passive in the specialized parable-setting formula
words.root_gloss_range: broad striking, setting forth, coining, traveling, and other branches; local formula selects setting forth a parable while preserving impact and coinage imagery
words.prose: {{ar:ضُرِبَ}} ({{tr:ḍuriba}}) is a perfect passive: the striker is not named, and {{ar:مَثَلٌۭ}} ({{tr:mathalun}}) becomes the promoted subject. The broad root can evoke impact and coinage, but the local formula narrows it to setting forth a parable; the result is a proof already struck before the audience is told to listen. The emphatic onset gives that parable launch a hard audible impact before the softer noun names the cognitive object. The same formulaic pattern is visible in 14:24, 16:75, and 36:78.

topics.headline: passive parable launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the parable itself moved to the foreground, with the striker suppressed and the proof presented as already set.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect passive whose subject is the following parable noun; V4 and CRITICAL rows support the parable-setting branch while limiting broader root branches.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative parable/model noun that frames the whole fly scenario
words.root_gloss_range: resemblance, example, model, standing, and likeness; local context selects an interpretive parable rather than a concrete object
words.prose: {{ar:مَثَلٌۭ}} ({{tr:mathalun}}) is indefinite and nominative as the passive subject of {{ar:ضُرِبَ}} ({{tr:ḍuriba}}). It introduces a fresh parable whose content unfolds through creation failure, retrieval failure, and the final weakness verdict. The root range reaches into standing resemblance and model-making, while the local abstract noun keeps the reader in an interpretive frame; the echo with 22:60 keeps measurement and likeness near the surface.

topics.headline: new parable as argument frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fly sequence is one sustained analogy, not a loose list of claims.
topics.reason: The grammar promotes the noun as passive subject and the following clauses supply the parable content; broader likeness senses are retained as cognitive-model pressure.

words.gloss_range: resultative conjunction attaching the announced parable to the listening command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds the parable announcement to {{ar:ٱسْتَمِعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istamiʿū}}). It is not loose sequence: because a parable has been set forth, active listening is now the required next move.

topics.headline: resultative link to listening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that listening is the immediate consequence of the parable being set forth.
topics.reason: QAC marks a resultative conjunction, and the CRITICAL rows consistently attach it to the imperative that follows.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII plural imperative requiring applied listening from the summoned audience
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, learning, comprehension, and obedience; local Form VIII imperative selects deliberate uptake of the parable
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَمِعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istamiʿū}}) is a plural imperative matching the public audience of {{ar:ٱلنَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nāsu}}). Its derived form makes listening deliberate and effortful, and the preceding {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes that effort the demanded uptake of the parable. The command also contrasts with {{ar:يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ}} ({{tr:yastanqidhūhu}}): humans are summoned to successful effortful hearing, while the invoked beings fail at effortful recovery.

topics.headline: deliberate collective listening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is commanded to apply itself to hearing, not merely to notice sound.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form VIII imperative 2mp; CRITICAL rows support deliberate listening, plural audience alignment, same-surah hearing echoes, and the contrast with the later Form X recovery verb.

words.gloss_range: directional lām with pronoun returning the command toward the parable
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) points the command back to {{ar:مَثَلٌۭ}} ({{tr:mathalun}}). The lām gives direction, and the suffix keeps the parable as the object of attention while the ayah moves into its content.

topics.headline: parable as listening target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the listening is aimed at this parable specifically, not at speech in general.
topics.reason: QAC parses lām plus third masculine suffix as directional, and the nearest coherent antecedent is the parable noun.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the parable content and governing a long claim
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the parable content with assertion-force. It governs the relative subject and drives toward the negated creation predicate, making the idol-incapacity claim something the listener must hear as stated truth, not as a tentative illustration.

topics.headline: emphatic truth claim opens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from summons and command into an asserted incapacity claim.
topics.reason: QAC marks the emphatic particle and its governed subject-predicate frame; CRITICAL rows identify the long emphatic clause.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun whose identity is supplied by the invocation clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not name the beings independently. It holds the subject open until {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}) defines them as the ones the audience calls; the grammar briefly grants them a personified plural frame before the proof strips that agency away.

topics.headline: invoked class defined by audience action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the supposed powers are introduced through what people do to them, before their incapacity is exposed.
topics.reason: QAC gives a masculine plural relative pronoun as the subject governed by the emphatic particle, and the CRITICAL rows tie its reference to the following relative clause.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperfect naming the audience as current agents of invocation
words.root_gloss_range: calling, invoking, petitioning, naming, and claiming; local context selects devotional invocation with claim-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}) is second-person plural, so the summoned people become the agents inside the proof. The root range includes calling, petitioning, and claiming; locally it exposes devotional invocation as a claim that the called beings can answer. Variant-style rows sharpen the point by contrast: the surface reading keeps the accusation in the second person. The direct address also carries the audience pressure forward from 22:72 into the parable. The same field answers 22:62, where what is called besides God is named false.

topics.headline: direct audience invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the parable directly implicates the listeners: their calling is real, while the called beings cannot create.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect 2mp indicative; CRITICAL rows on variants are retained as contrast, while the local surface keeps the direct-address force.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the exclusion phrase and attaching it to invocation
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the exclusion complex attached to {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}). It governs {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) and carries separation rather than partitive extraction: the invoked beings are classified as apart from the divine referent, not as a share taken from Him. After the hostile scene of 22:72, this preposition turns the issue into an analytic boundary: invocation from apart from God.

topics.headline: separation begins exclusion complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the critique is not generic calling, but calling from apart from God.
topics.reason: QAC parses the particle as a preposition governing the following genitive phrase and marking exclusion in this idiom.

words.gloss_range: semi-prepositional genitive noun marking exclusion and inferiority relative to God
words.root_gloss_range: below, short of, apart from, and inferior; local construct selects the exclusion-threshold sense measured by the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is bound to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) in a genitive relation. Its root field can carry below-ness, apartness, and inferiority; in {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}), those pressures converge into an exclusion threshold measured by God. The same surah has already returned to this field in 22:12, 22:62, and 22:71.

topics.headline: below-and-besides relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase means more than other-than: it places the invoked beings beneath and outside the divine standard.
topics.reason: QAC parses a genitive semi-prepositional noun; the broader spatial/evaluative field is locally narrowed by the construct relation with the proper divine name.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive position as the anchor of the exclusion phrase
words.root_gloss_range: worship, divinity, and bewilderment fields; local form is the proper name functioning as the unique standard, not a count noun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) closes the exclusion phrase as its fixed standard. The local form is the proper divine name, not a pluralizable class label; against it, {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) and {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}) introduce beings whose identity depends on human calling. The surrounding surah has already contrasted powerless called objects with divine agency, especially at 22:12 and 22:62.

topics.headline: proper divine standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between a proper divine referent and beings defined only by being invoked.
topics.reason: QAC places the proper noun in genitive after the semi-preposition; V4 derivational notes are retained only as background to the proper-name anchor.

words.gloss_range: negating particle governing the following subjunctive and denying future creative capacity
words.prose: {{ar:لَن}} ({{tr:lan}}) governs {{ar:يَخْلُقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yakhluqū}}) and launches the first incapacity test. Its force is strong future negation; the debated permanence claim need not be overstated, because the local point is already decisive: even under the coming concession, the invoked beings will not create.

topics.headline: future creation denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creative capacity is denied before any favorable assembly condition is granted.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle governing the subjunctive creation verb; CRITICAL rows on permanent negation are narrowed to strong local future denial.

words.gloss_range: Form I subjunctive creation verb governed by negation, with the invoked class as plural subject
words.root_gloss_range: creating, proportioning, forming, and fabrication; locally true creation of a fly is the challenged capacity
words.prose: {{ar:يَخْلُقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yakhluqū}}) is the negated creation predicate for the invoked class. The surface uses plain Form I, so the proof does not need an intensified verb: they fail at the basic act of bringing a creature into being. The root often belongs with heavens-and-earth creation, but here it is narrowed to {{ar:ذُبَابًۭا}} ({{tr:dhubāban}}), making the incapacity more humiliating rather than smaller. Its hard guttural and stop texture frames the creation verb before the light fly target. The echo with 22:5 turns Surah 22 creation discourse against non-creating objects of appeal.

topics.headline: plain creation fails at smallest scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices cosmic creation vocabulary miniaturized to a fly: failure at the smallest target defeats the largest claim.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form I imperfect subjunctive governed by the negator; CRITICAL rows on fabrication and cosmic scale are preserved as polemical pressure around the local creation sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative fly as the direct object of the creation challenge
words.root_gloss_range: fly, buzzing, repelled-returning movement, tiny point, and related minute images; locally the concrete fly is selected as minimal living target
words.prose: {{ar:ذُبَابًۭا}} ({{tr:dhubāban}}) is the direct object of {{ar:يَخْلُقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yakhluqū}}): one unspecified fly, any fly. The rare root field can carry buzzing, repelled-returning movement, and tiny-point imagery, but the local noun remains the concrete minimal creature. This same word returns as {{ar:ٱلذُّبَابُ}} ({{tr:al-dhubābu}}), shifting from impossible creation-object to active subject; because the supplied occurrence evidence places both fly mentions in this ayah, the two roles define the parable together.

topics.headline: indefinite fly as minimal target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the challenge reduced to one unspecified fly, which makes the failure maximal.
topics.reason: QAC gives an indefinite accusative object of the creation verb; CRITICAL rarity and root-image rows survive as local minimality and role-reversal payoff.

words.gloss_range: conjunction functioning concessively with the following conditional particle
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) works with {{ar:لَوِ}} ({{tr:lawi}}) as a concessive frame. It does not simply add another event; it subordinates the assembly scene under the already declared creation failure. That role also sets up the contrast with the later {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), which coordinates a fresh retrieval scenario.

topics.headline: concession before assembly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah grants the invoked beings the strongest imagined circumstance before denying creation.
topics.reason: QAC notes concessive or circumstantial force with the following conditional particle, matching the CRITICAL distinction from later simple coordination.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual or concessive conditional particle introducing total assembly as an unreal best-case scenario
words.prose: {{ar:لَوِ}} ({{tr:lawi}}) frames {{ar:ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:ijtamaʿū}}) as a favorable hypothetical: even if all the invoked beings assembled, the prior negation would stand. Its contrast with {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) matters, because the ayah moves from an unreal best-case capability claim to a realistic humiliation scenario. The supplied recitational liaison variant sharpens the boundary without changing that logic.

topics.headline: best-case hypothetical denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the modal contrast: total assembly is a hypothetical concession, while the fly’s later snatching is treated as live possibility.
topics.reason: QAC marks a concessive conditional particle; variant rows are retained as form evidence only, not as a different local syntax.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII perfect plural assembly inside the concessive conditional
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, unifying, consensus, and confluence; locally deliberate coming together of the invoked class is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:ijtamaʿū}}) grants the invoked beings collective convergence. The Form VIII shape lets them come together deliberately, and the perfect inside {{ar:لَوِ}} ({{tr:lawi}}) gives the concession a completed feel, as though full assembly had already been granted. The root range can include collection and consensus, but locally the point is pooled capacity directed toward {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) and still unable to create.

topics.headline: pooled capacity still fails
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even maximal pooled capacity cannot become creative power.
topics.reason: QAC parses a Form VIII perfect plural in the concessive clause; broader gathering senses are narrowed to deliberate assembly under the creation test.

words.gloss_range: purposive lām with pronoun marking the goal of the assembly
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) attaches to {{ar:ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:ijtamaʿū}}) and marks purpose. The suffix points back to {{ar:ذُبَابًۭا}} ({{tr:dhubāban}}) and the task of creating it, so the failure cannot be blamed on lack of coordination or lack of aim.

topics.headline: assembly aimed at the fly task
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failed assembly is not aimless; it is explicitly directed toward the fly-creation task.
topics.reason: QAC identifies purposive lām plus pronoun, and the CRITICAL rows bind its referent to the fly-creation task.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction opening the second scenario and escalating the proof
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens a fresh scenario. Grammatically it coordinates, but argumentatively it escalates downward: after failing to create the fly, the invoked beings also fail at the lower task of recovering anything from it.

topics.headline: coordination into lower test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument move from inability to create to inability to recover after loss.
topics.reason: QAC marks coordination before the conditional particle; CRITICAL rows identify the move from creation failure to retrieval failure.

words.gloss_range: real conditional particle opening the fly-snatching protasis
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) governs the snatching clause as a real condition. Against {{ar:لَوِ}} ({{tr:lawi}}), which grants an unreal best-case assembly, this particle makes the fly’s act a live possibility whose answer is immediate incapacity.

topics.headline: real condition for fly snatching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second humiliation is practically imaginable, not merely a hypothetical concession.
topics.reason: QAC contrasts the real conditional particle with the earlier concessive counterfactual particle, and the CRITICAL rows build the modal contrast.

words.gloss_range: Form I jussive plunder verb with the victims embedded as object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: stripping, plundering, despoiling, and deprivation; locally the fly forcibly takes from the invoked beings
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْلُبْهُمُ}} ({{tr:yaslubhumu}}) places the victims inside the verb before {{ar:ٱلذُّبَابُ}} ({{tr:al-dhubābu}}) is named as subject. The root means stripping or plundering, not neutral taking; the ordinary Form I is enough for the fly to dispossess the beings treated as powerful. Set inside a real conditional, this rare and violent verb makes the second test harsher than mere non-creation. Its rarity in the supplied data makes this mundane fly-theft the unique local vehicle for plunder language.

topics.headline: fly strips the supposed powers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the power reversal: the fly becomes the plunderer and the invoked beings are heard first as victims.
topics.reason: QAC parses a Form I jussive in the real conditional with object suffix; CRITICAL rows on violence, suffix placement, and hapax status support the reversal without requiring an intensive stem.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative fly as subject of the plunder verb, resuming the earlier indefinite fly
words.root_gloss_range: same concrete fly field as the earlier occurrence, now activated in subject position
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلذُّبَابُ}} ({{tr:al-dhubābu}}) returns the earlier {{ar:ذُبَابًۭا}} ({{tr:dhubāban}}) with definiteness and nominative case. The creature first named as the impossible object of creation now becomes the identified subject of plunder. That object-to-agent turn is the parable’s central reversal, and the repeated sound makes the fly’s return audible as well as grammatical.

topics.headline: fly returns as acting subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the central pivot: the fly that could not be created now acts against them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a definite nominative subject of the plunder verb; the CRITICAL rows converge on definiteness shift, role reversal, and local repetition.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object of the fly’s plunder, broadening the loss to anything at all
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, object, entity, and will-related background; locally an indefinite any-thing object is selected
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) is the object of {{ar:يَسْلُبْهُمُ}} ({{tr:yaslubhumu}}). Its indefiniteness inside the conditional makes the stolen object maximally open: any thing at all is enough to expose their failure. The root’s will-related background can remain as pressure around possession and control, while the local sense is simply the broadest minimal object. Same-surah creation and power echoes make even this unspecified thing part of the larger test of what can be caused, possessed, or controlled.

topics.headline: any stolen thing is enough
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the retrieval test is lowered to the smallest unspecified loss.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite accusative object; CRITICAL semantic rows are narrowed by the conditional syntax to the any-thing minimizer payoff.

words.gloss_range: negation particle beginning the conditional answer and denying recovery
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the answer to the condition opened by {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}). It differs from {{ar:لَن}} ({{tr:lan}}): the first negation denied future creation, while this one denies effective recovery once the fly has taken something.

topics.headline: negative answer to loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fly’s taking resolves immediately into failed recovery.
topics.reason: QAC marks the negation particle before the recovery verb in the conditional apodosis; CRITICAL rows distinguish it from the earlier negator.

words.gloss_range: Form X imperfect recovery verb negated in the conditional answer, with object and source split by suffixes
words.root_gloss_range: rescue, deliverance, and saving; locally Form X plus object-source grammar selects attempted retrieval
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ}} ({{tr:yastanqidhūhu}}) is Form X, so the morphology carries sought rescue or attempted recovery before {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) cancels it. The root can mean rescue and deliverance, but the suffix for the stolen thing and {{ar:مِنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) as source narrow the local sense to retrieval from the fly. The supplied rarity of the rescue field makes the failure sharper: scarce rescue vocabulary is spent on a recovery that cannot happen. This failed effort contrasts with {{ar:ٱسْتَمِعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istamiʿū}}): human effortful listening is commanded, while idol effortful recovery collapses.

topics.headline: attempted retrieval fails
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure reaches even the attempt-route: they cannot retrieve what a fly has taken.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form X imperfect with object suffix; CRITICAL rows on rescue breadth are narrowed by the local object-source relation and negated apodosis.

words.gloss_range: source/separation preposition with suffix returning to the fly
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) closes the recovery clause by marking the source from which retrieval fails. Its suffix points to {{ar:ٱلذُّبَابُ}} ({{tr:al-dhubābu}}), while the suffix in {{ar:يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ}} ({{tr:yastanqidhūhu}}) points to {{ar:شَيْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}); the same pronoun shape therefore separates the thing sought back from the fly that holds it.

topics.headline: fly remains the holder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final pronoun sends the recovery attempt back to the fly as controlling holder.
topics.reason: QAC identifies min plus third masculine suffix as a source marker referring to the fly, and CRITICAL rows account for the two-pronoun antecedent split.

words.gloss_range: stative perfect opening the final verdict over the coordinated role pair
words.root_gloss_range: weakness and doubling or multiplication fields; locally a stative weakness verdict is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ضَعُفَ}} ({{tr:ḍaʿufa}}) opens the closing verdict before the two subjects are unpacked. Its stative perfect declares weakness as an inherent quality, not an event caused by someone else. The root’s doubling field lets weakness feel compounded across {{ar:ٱلطَّالِبُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭālibu}}) and {{ar:ٱلْمَطْلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-maṭlūbu}}), while the local form blocks an oppression or causative weakening reading. The heavy onset gives the compressed verdict a blunt audible force before the paired participles spell out who shares it. The ayah begins the proof with {{ar:ضُرِبَ}} ({{tr:ḍuriba}}) and lands here on judgment.

topics.headline: inherent weakness verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns the two failed tests into a general verdict of inherent shared weakness.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form I perfect with stative faʿula value; CRITICAL rows on doubling and oppression-field are retained only where they support the coordinated verdict.

words.gloss_range: definite active participle turning seeking into a recognizable role under the weakness verdict
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, pursuing, requesting, petitioning, learning, and being demanded; locally an active participial seeker role is judged
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطَّالِبُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭālibu}}) is a definite active participle and the first named bearer of {{ar:ضَعُفَ}} ({{tr:ḍaʿufa}}). It labels a characteristic seeker rather than one completed act. The referent remains deliberately open: the worshipper seeking help, the idol seeking recovery, and the pursuit-chain all remain exposed. Near the creation and retrieval tests, the role shows seeking unable to become creative or rescuing power. Its form also prepares the mirror with {{ar:ٱلْمَطْلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-maṭlūbu}}), where the same root returns in passive role.

topics.headline: definite seeker under judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeking itself becomes a judged role, and the referent remains broad enough to indict worshippers, idols, and the pursuit-chain.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite nominative active participle; CRITICAL rows on ambiguity, habitual role, creation proximity, and uniqueness are all coherent with the local verdict.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining active and passive role labels under one predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates {{ar:ٱلطَّالِبُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭālibu}}) and {{ar:ٱلْمَطْلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-maṭlūbu}}) under one predicate. It prevents the second role from becoming apposition and levels both sides of pursuit as equal bearers of weakness.

topics.headline: seeker and sought leveled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the active and passive roles share the same verdict without hierarchy.
topics.reason: QAC marks a coordinating conjunction linking the two participles; CRITICAL rows consistently treat it as leveling coordination.

words.gloss_range: definite passive participle completing the coordinated subject and closing the verdict
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, being sought, demanded party, and request-chain roles; locally the passive participial sought role is judged while referential openness remains
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَطْلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-maṭlūbu}}) completes the subject of {{ar:ضَعُفَ}} ({{tr:ḍaʿufa}}) and becomes the final word. Its definite passive participle mirrors {{ar:ٱلطَّالِبُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭālibu}}) in the same root while reversing voice, so the verdict closes as an active-passive loop. The possible referents remain generatively open: idols sought for help, the fly sought for recovery, or the thing sought back; that openness lets the weakness strike every participant in the failed request chain. The supplied uniqueness of this participial form intensifies its role as the ayah’s final verdict label.

topics.headline: sought role closes the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on the passive endpoint of failed seeking, with seeker and sought trapped in the same weakness.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite nominative passive participle coordinated with the active participle; CRITICAL rows support referential openness, legal demand-register, final-word closure, and active-passive mirroring.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus moves from the inability to create one fly to the inability to recover one unspecified thing taken by it, then names both seeker and sought weak.
baseline_models.mechanism: The struck parable acts as a two-stage threshold for agency: originate a minimal living actor, then retain or recover a minimal object when that actor removes it. Failure in both production and custody grounds the closing judgment of weakness.

activation_trace.role: The branch images the showing of a parable and frames the sequence as a deliberately exposed test.
The branch makes the example an admonitory sign whose details carry evidentiary force.
The branch supplies prior measuring and fitting, so even the design threshold fails before execution.
The branch supplies actual origination and makes the fly the minimum production test.
The literal fly supplies the deliberately minute living agent in both halves of the assay.
The maximally general knowable thing keeps the custody threshold materially unspecified and therefore minimal.
Extraction from another's possession supplies the failed recovery stage.
The direct contrary of power states the result shared by the relation's two poles.

changed_reading.before: The fly is merely a taunting image of smallness.
changed_reading.after: The fly runs a reproducible agency assay across design, origination, custody, and recovery.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concession 'even if they assembled for it' places collective coordination between the creation challenge and the fly's taking.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aggregation gathers bodies, plans, and force, but no amount of coordination crosses the tiny threshold. The parable therefore denies that plural membership or concerted resolve can manufacture agency.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally joins dispersed members and supplies coalition formation.
Gathered and resolved opinion supplies coordinated planning, which still cannot create the fly.
Collected force supplies the strongest version of pooled capacity before its nullification.
Weakness remains the output after every available unit of force has been gathered.

changed_reading.before: Each invoked being is individually too weak to create a fly.
changed_reading.after: The verse tests and rejects the stronger hypothesis that coalition, planning, or pooled force can aggregate into divine agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Calling beings below or besides God opens a dependency relation, while the closing active and passive participles leave the seeker and sought jointly weak.
baseline_models.mechanism: Invocation is simultaneously a call and a claim about entitlement or affiliation. The seeker/sought closure destabilizes every assignment of helper, petitioner, pursuer, and quarry without forcing one referential solution: whichever pole is active and whichever is targeted, the relation cannot deliver its object.

activation_trace.role: The call that inclines another by speech establishes the petitioning relation.
The branch of asserted right or affiliation exposes invocation as a claim about status, not sound alone.
Nearness that falls short of the limit places the invoked party below the required agency threshold.
Otherness supplies the substitution relation in which a lesser party is installed besides God.
Seeking and repeated pursuit animate both active and passive participles without settling their referents.
Demanding a due right turns the stolen thing into an unmet claim within the dependency relation.
The final weakness applies across both grammatical poles and preserves their reversible assignments.

changed_reading.before: The conclusion labels only the adored objects weak.
changed_reading.after: The conclusion exposes a failed dependency circuit in which caller, called party, pursuer, quarry, claimant, and claimed object remain deliberately reassignable yet jointly powerless.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A universal human address immediately commands attentive hearing of the struck parable before presenting its test.
baseline_models.mechanism: The parable is not ornamental comparison but a public proof event. Hearing activates understanding and compliance, so the audience is asked to submit its claims about power to the observable sequence rather than merely register its sound.

activation_trace.role: Recognition through sight, sensation, or hearing makes the human address a demand for perceptive acknowledgment.
The example is pictured and exposed for public inspection.
The struck parable supplies the compact demonstration to which the audience must attend.
Hearing as understanding and compliance converts audition into adjudicative response.

changed_reading.before: Listening is a prefatory request for attention.
changed_reading.after: Listening is the required epistemic act by which the audience lets a small observable mechanism judge its power claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence from fluid drop through adhesion and a chewed-like lump, followed later by life, death, and life, activates creation as governed transformation. The fly challenge consequently tests production of a living continuity rather than assembly of a static shape.

activation_trace.role: A clear drop extending to generative fluid supplies the first changing material state.
Attachment and adherence supply a second process state rather than a finished artifact.
The chewed-like piece supplies formed but still transitional matter.
Living animate existence makes creation's target an organism, not a molded likeness.
Loss of force and life supplies the reversible boundary that true life-governance crosses.
Origination anchors the contextual process model directly to the fly challenge.
Mere joining of components is the insufficient alternative to governed living development.

structural_cues: 22:5 explicitly orders successive embodied stages rather than naming a finished human only.
22:66 alternates giving life, causing death, and giving life again.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged generation and recurring life-governance; I infer that one fly invokes the same processual standard and that assembly is its counterfeit. A live alternative is the narrower reading of create as simple origination without lifecycle emphasis.

changed_reading.before: Creating a fly means manufacturing a tiny finished object.
changed_reading.after: Creating a fly means governing a living developmental continuity that collected parts and pooled labor cannot reproduce.

context_deltas.mechanism: The associator who falls, is lightly snatched by a bird, or plunges with the wind reappears in miniature when a fly dispossesses the invoked beings. Across the two images, claimed masters repeatedly become movable objects inside creature-scale forces.

activation_trace.role: Noisy unstable falling begins the loss of the associator's subject position.
Light, rapid snatching supplies the earlier creature-mediated dispossession.
Falling into an abyss completes the transfer from agent to carried object.
The fly's restless motion supplies the tiny, hard-to-stabilize agent of the second dispossession.
Failed extraction confirms that the supposed powers have become victims rather than controllers.
The pursuer and pursued pair preserves shifting subject and object roles at the close.

structural_cues: 22:31 places the associator in a fall-snatch-plunge sequence driven by bird or wind.
22:73 reverses expected scale by making the adored plurality the party dispossessed by a fly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two creature-mediated losses of control; I connect them as repeated role reversal from master to cargo or prey. They may alternatively remain independent similitudes whose only shared feature is helplessness.

changed_reading.before: The fly matters because it is smaller than the idols.
changed_reading.after: The fly completes a recurrent reversal in which claims of mastery convert their holders into carried, snatched, or pursued objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sacrificial flesh and blood do not reach God while piety does; the false powers, by contrast, cannot recover even an unspecified thing taken from them. The repeated material non-transfer separates divine non-need from creaturely non-capacity.

activation_trace.role: Attainment distinguishes what does not reach God materially from what reaches as piety.
Transfer to another supplies the directionality whose material and ethical channels are contrasted.
Purposeful subjection places sacrificial matter under real governance without making it divine nourishment.
The generic thing is the smallest possible material transfer whose loss still defeats the invoked powers.
Failed recovery marks inability to reverse a transfer, unlike God's non-need for the transferred matter.

structural_cues: 22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with piety as two modes of reaching.
Both 22:37 and the creation clause of 22:73 use emphatic future negation, but for opposite reasons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed material reach to God and failed material recovery by lesser powers; I infer a deliberate contrast between transcendence and impotence. The alternative is that 22:37 concerns ritual sincerity without activating custody in 22:73.

changed_reading.before: The stolen thing only demonstrates that idols cannot protect property.
changed_reading.after: The thing participates in a transfer contrast: God is not reached by sacrificial matter because He does not need it, whereas false powers fail because they cannot govern matter at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context attributes defense, aid, and a preserving holdfast to God. Against that network, the fly episode audits guardianship: the invoked parties cannot repel intrusion, protect their possession, recover it, or become a hold for their callers.

activation_trace.role: Pushing harm away supplies the positive model of active divine defense.
Aid that manifests the aided party supplies effective patronage in the social field.
A grasp that prevents and preserves supplies the surah's closing image of reliable attachment.
The latent fly-root image of repelling and protecting makes the failure to ward off the fly a guardianship failure.
Inability to extract the object from another's possession is the failed rescue counterpart to defense and holdfast.

structural_cues: 22:40 makes mutual human checking preserve sanctuaries and pairs it with divine aid.
22:78 closes by naming God patron and helper immediately after the command to hold fast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defense, aid, preservation, and the focus's failed recovery; I infer a shared guardianship criterion. A live alternative is that the fly tests creative power only and the protection network is a broader contextual contrast.

changed_reading.before: The parable tests whether an invoked being can make and retrieve objects.
changed_reading.after: The parable audits the entire patronage promise: repulsion, custody, rescue, and a stable hold all fail at the false pole and remain available at the divine pole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship is purposefully subjected and the sky continuously held from falling; immediately against that scale, the invoked collective cannot retain or recover one thing from a fly. Power is measured not only by first creation but by sustained anti-collapse governance.

activation_trace.role: Subjection and direction toward a purpose supply controlled motion at environmental scale.
Holding and restraining supply the positive capacity to preserve a system continuously.
Falling and settling name the collapse actively withheld.
The failed extraction of one object supplies the microscopic counterexample to sustained control.
Weakness names inability to govern even the smallest unstable relation.

structural_cues: 22:65 coordinates ship motion, command, sky-holding, and prevented falling in one sentence.
22:73 descends from environmental control to custody of one thing without abandoning the criterion of control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuous cosmic retention and one failed recovery; I infer that both instantiate governance over trajectories. They may alternatively function as a simple maximal/minimal contrast rather than one control model.

changed_reading.before: Creation is the only relevant signature of power in the focus.
changed_reading.after: Creation and continuous retention are co-signatures: the one who holds a sky governs, while those who cannot retain a thing do not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier challengers strive as mu'ajizin, activating both causing failure and escaping pursuit. In the focus, the adored collective is actually incapacitated and outstripped: the fly departs with the object, while seeker and sought cannot complete pursuit or recovery.

activation_trace.role: Incapacity and shortfall supply the state the challengers project but the invoked powers actually display.
Outrunning and escaping pursuit supply the fly's inferred role as quarry that cannot be caught.
Search and repeated pursuit anchor the outstripping image to the seeker/sought closure.
A target made distant enough to require pursuit sharpens the escaped-quarry mechanism.
Failure to recover the object makes the pursuit failure operational rather than rhetorical.

structural_cues: 22:51 describes striving against the signs with the ambiguous pursuit/failure form mu'ajizin.
22:73 closes with an active/passive pursuit pair after an unreversed taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the dual branch of incapacity and escaping pursuit; I assign the fly the escaped-quarry role and the alleged powers the outstripped-pursuer role. The live alternative keeps mu'ajizin at 22:51 strictly as attempted frustration without chase imagery.

changed_reading.before: The final weakness is a static lack of strength.
changed_reading.after: The weakness becomes kinetic defeat: the smallest quarry outstrips the assembled pursuers and leaves their claim unrecovered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes ears that produce understanding from hearts that remain blind, then depicts voiced recitation answered by near assault. The focus imperative to listen offers a disciplined replacement for hostile reception: follow the voiced sign into comprehension before acting against its bearer.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance connects the ear explicitly to inward discernment.
One sound following another supplies voiced recitation as the sequence confronting the hearer.
The imperative demands comprehension and responsive submission to the parable's mechanism.
The parable as sign and admonition gives hearing a determinate object for reflection.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts functioning ears with blind hearts.
The branchless root س ط و at 22:72 word 13 marks the hearers' near assault and is retained only as structural support.
22:73 answers that reception posture with a direct command to listen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward hearing, serial recitation, near assault, and the focus imperative; I infer a deliberate conversion from reactive force to patient adjudication. The command may alternatively be a local attention marker without direct reference to 22:72's hostility.

changed_reading.before: Listen means pause long enough to hear the example.

activation_trace.role: Throwing an item into a field supplies the foreign insertion in the discourse analogy.

strongest_changes: The fly became a two-stage assay of origination and custody rather than a generic emblem of smallness.
The context separated divine non-need in material transfer from the false powers' inability to govern matter.
Defense, aid, holdfast, and cosmic retention expanded failed recovery into a broader guardianship test.
The command to listen became an ethical alternative to hostile reception and a method of adjudicating power claims.
The immediate sequel turned the parable into a calibration procedure exposing a category error in measuring divine power.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains several coexisting mechanisms without requiring one referential solution for الطالب والمطلوب: minimum-capacity testing, coalition failure, dependency collapse, creature/prey reversal, ritual transfer, protection, cosmic governance, juridical claim, and disciplined hearing. Its strangest live activations are that assembly can compound weakness, fabricated divinity can be contrasted with actual creation, a split-root call can prop up the invoked helper, and material custody can analogize information integrity.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referents of الطالب and المطلوب remain deliberately unresolved; caller, idol, fly, stolen thing, pursuer, and quarry support more than one assignment.
The stolen شيء may evoke offering, property, generic matter, or merely the smallest possible object; the focus does not specify it.
The lifecycle, claim-settlement, and message-custody readings require reader-supplied arrows and should coexist with the simpler capacity assay rather than replace it.
The doubled-weakness and fallen-invokee outliers depend on branch play, so they should never be presented as primary lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The example demands compliant hearing and material testing.** `ض ر ب B003/B001` sets forth an example by making an impact; `م ث ل B003/B011` parable and lesson; `س م ع B003/B001` compliant understanding and hearing; `خ ل ق B001/B002` proportioning and originating. The command to listen precedes a concrete inability test. I infer that proper hearing follows the analogy through causal consequences. The parable reads as an experiment in agency, not ornamental comparison.
2. **Collected claimants fail against one oscillating creature.** `ج م ع B001/B010` gathers scattered agents and concentrates force; `ذ ب ب B001/B004` is fly and wavering motion; `س ل ب B001` strips away; `ن ق ذ B001` rescues; `ض ع ف B001` lacks strength. Even totalized cooperation cannot create the fly or recover what it removes. I infer that aggregation cannot supply a missing kind of creative power. The small creature reverses the expected hierarchy by exposing collective incapacity.
3. **Seeker and sought form a closed circuit of need.** Repeated `ط ل ب B001/B005` supplies seeking and making another need to seek. The worshipper seeks the object, while both become implicated in recovering what the fly takes. I infer that an object requiring rescue cannot terminate another's need. The final equality in weakness reads as a failed dependency circuit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:74 named the parable's diagnosis: the weak dependency circuit results from failing to measure God according to the due extent of divine power.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The parable tests power by creation and recovery at the smallest scale.** Fixed `ضُرِبَ` activates `ض ر ب:B003` (setting forth an example), `مَثَل` activates `م ث ل:B003` (parable), and `ٱسْتَمِعُوا` permits `س م ع:B003` (hearing as understanding/compliance). What is called besides God (`د ع و:B001`; `د و ن:B003`) cannot `خ ل ق:B002` (bring into being) even a `ذ ب ب:B001` (fly), despite `ج م ع:B001` (gathering into a collected whole). If the fly uses `س ل ب:B001` (snatching away), they cannot use `ن ق ذ:B001` (rescue or extrication). `22:71` supplied missing authority and aid; `22:74` names the resulting mismeasurement. The packet supplies two directional tests; I infer that genuine agency must originate and recover, not merely receive invocation. Collective size cannot compensate for absent causal capacity.
2. **Seeker and sought collapse into reciprocal weakness.** Fixed doubled `ط ل ب:B001` supplies seeking, while `ض ع ف:B001` states lack of strength. The invoked powers are sought by worshippers yet themselves cannot retrieve what a fly takes; the fly temporarily occupies the effective taker-role. I infer a role inversion that destabilizes the presumed hierarchy. The closing diagnosis applies to the whole relation, not just one party.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:74` names the failed comparison as mismeasurement, while `22:75` contrasts self-gathered impotence with source-selected messengers. The parable therefore tests both raw capacity and legitimate mediation.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir duygusal ilişkiyi, komşu dal ise bir varlık sınıfını adlandırır. İnsan olmak yakınlık hissetmeyi gerektirmez ve iki ifade birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı. Alışıp bağlanma, özel dostluk ve insan türünü adlandırma alanları dal sınırını en açık gösterdiği için yalnız bu üç ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنس بمعنى البشر ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyin insana bakan veya en yakın olan yanı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir nesnenin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük yanını ilişkiye göre belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak ön, önde, yakın veya karşıda bulunma yönlerini kişiye bağlı bir kullanım ilişkisi gerektirmeden anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insana dönük yan ile genel ön taraf
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin bakana göre karşıda veya önde kalan bölümünü gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yön, insanın nesneyle kurduğu konum veya kullanım ilişkisine bağlıdır. Komşu dalın genel ön ve yakın anlamları bu özel bağı gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yönelme tamamlandıktan sonra insana dönük olan sabit yanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüz, baş, el, kap veya hayvanın bir hedefe doğru dönmesi ve yönelmesi eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişi veya hedefe doğru bakma yönünü içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bir nesnenin insana dönük yanı bir bölüm adıdır; komşu ise dönme veya yönelme olayını anlatır. Sonuç konumu ile o konuma geçiş eylemi birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin arkasında kalan, yüzünün karşıtı olan arka bölümünü gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insana bakan yan ile arka taraf
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesnenin başka bir yöne göre belirlenen bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bağlama göre karşıt görünebilseler de odak dal her zaman geometrik ön yüz değildir ve bu yüzden düzenli bir karşıt çift oluşturmaz; belirleyici ölçüt insana yakınlıktır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Genel ön taraf, yönelme eylemi ve arka bölümle kurulan karşılaştırmalar insana göre belirlenen yanın sınırını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان نفسه ولا الأنس النفسي ولا الإبصار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakanın göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntü adlandırıldığında dalın ortak ve temel anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğindeki konumunu, küçüklüğünü ve yansıma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yansımanın insan biçiminde algılanması özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğinde bulunmasını ve küçük insan biçiminde görünmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız parmak ucunu aynı adla veren ayrı kaynak kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Göz anlamından bağımsız olan parmak ucu kullanımını doğrudan korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntü veya yansıma
parmak ucu; eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal göz bebeğinin kendisini, onun kara bölümünü ve anatomik yapısını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: göz bebeği ile göz bebeğindeki yansıma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı göz bölgesine gönderimde bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu anatomik bölümün kendisidir; odak dal ise o bölümde görülen görüntüdür. Taşıyıcı yapı ile üzerinde beliren yansıma birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü ve ayrı bir parmak ucu varyantını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal resim, model, heykel veya başka bir varlığa göre biçimlendirilmiş genel örnekleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal başka bir varlığın görünüşünü taşıyan bir görüntüyü anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak görüntü göz bebeğindeki belirli yansımadır; komşu ise konum ve oluşum biçimi bakımından çok daha genel tasvirleri kapsar. Her tasvir gözdeki yansıma değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gören gözün içinde beliren küçük görüntüyü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal görme organı olan gözün kendisini ve onun görme işlevini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: göz organı ile içindeki küçük görüntü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal göz ve görme alanına aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Göz, görmeyi sağlayan organdır; odak dal ise gözde görülen yansımadır. Organın adı yansımanın, yansımanın adı da organın genel karşılığı değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi. Anatomik göz bebeği, genel tasvir ve göz organı karşılaştırmaları görüntünün yerini ve türünü en iyi sınırladığı için bu üçü yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان بمعنى البشر عموما ولا الأنس بمعنى الراحة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: إنسان العين صبيها الذي في السواد (maqayis)؛ إنسان العين المثال الذي يرى في السواد أي سواد العين (sihah)؛ الإنسان أيضا إنسان العين وجمعه أناسي والإنسان الأنملة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen söz kuruluşlarında kişinin kendisini veya seçkin yakınını gösterir; genel insan, gerçek evlatlık ve her türlü arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendisi ile onun seçilmiş yakını arasındaki iki ayrı gönderimi ve kuruluş sınırlamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Muhataba kendi durumunun nasıl olduğu sorulduğunda doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sorunun muhatabın kendi durumuna yönelmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin seçip özel tuttuğu yakın arkadaş veya sırdaş anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yakın kişinin seçilmiş, özel ve güvenilen biri olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın dost, içten arkadaş ve birlikte oturup konuşulan kişi için sıralanan paralel adları açıklarken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık, dostluk ve sürekli görüşme ilişkilerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yakınım, içten dostum ve görüşme arkadaşım

error_profile.preserves: Kuruluşun yüzeyindeki çocuk ve soy ilişkisi çağrışımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendisini veya seçilmiş yakınını gösteren kalıplaşmış gönderimi kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Gerçek bir baba ile erkek çocuk arasındaki soy ilişkisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sözün amaçlanan kişi ilişkisini gerçek akrabalıkla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin kendisini belirli bir soru kuruluşunda gösterir ve ayrıca seçilmiş yakın anlamını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şiirsel bir söyleyişte yalnız kişinin kendi benliğini başka bir kalıpla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kişinin kendisini gösteren iki ayrı söz
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli bir söz kuruluşunda kişinin kendisine gönderimde bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak gönderim yalnız benlik anlamındadır; kuruluşlar değiştirilemez. Odak dalın seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş anlamı komşuda bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal seçilmiş yakını ve sırdaşı gösterebilir, fakat kişinin kendisini soran ayrı bir kullanım da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişinin işine ve sırrına alınan bütün iç çevreyi ve özel kişileri topluluk olarak kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Güvenilen ve özel tutulan kişi iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çoğunlukla tek bir yakın veya sırdaşı gösterir; komşu kişinin iç çevresini ve işlerine alınan özel kişileri daha geniş kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özel kuruluşlarla kişinin kendisini ya da seçilmiş yakınını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal arkadaşlık ve dostluk ilişkisini açık ya da gizli yönleriyle genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Seçilmiş yakın kişi aynı zamanda dost veya arkadaş olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Her dost odak daldaki özel adlandırmanın taşıdığı seçilmiş yakın değildir; odak dalın kişinin kendisine gönderimi de genel dostluk alanının dışındadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday kartların tamamı incelendi. Kişinin kendisini gösteren başka kuruluş, iç çevre ve genel dostluk alanları iki ayrı gönderimi en iyi sınırlandırdığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل مطلق الإنسان ولا مطلق المؤانسة إلا إذا جاء بصيغة هذا الباب أو قرينته.
branches.source_phrase_ar: كيف ابن إنسك إذا سأله عن نفسه (maqayis)؛ كيف ابن إنسك يعني نفسه وفلان ابن إنس فلان أي صفيه وخاصته وهذا خدني وإنسي وخلصي وجلسي (sihah)؛ كيف ترى ابن إنسك إذا خاطبت الرجل عن نفسه وفلان ابن أنس فلان أي صفيه وأنيسه (tahdhib)؛ قيل ابن إنسك للنفس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız eve giriş öncesindeki belirli söz çevresinde açıklanır. Bir aktarım bunu selam verip izin isteme ve girebilir miyim diye sorma olarak, diğeri ise girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulma olarak yorumlar. Dal bu iki açıklamayı korumalı, fakat çıplak biçime genel bakma veya genel rahatlık anlamı yüklememelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal eve girmeden önce izin ve kabul arama durumuyla sınırlıdır; genel görme, genel yakınlık, eve yerleşme veya barınma anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir ve eldeki kanıt yalnız giriş öncesi kuruluşu gösterir. Bu nedenle tanım bu söz çevresine bağlanır, çıplak bir genel anlam varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eve girmeden önce selam vererek izin istemeyi ve içeridekilerin girişe açık olduğunu anlamayı anlatır. Aktarımın bir yönü doğrudan izin sorusunu, diğer yönü girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmayı öne çıkarır.

facets.statement: Eve girmeden önce selam verip girmek için izin istemeyi ve kabul beklemeyi anlatır.
Ayrı açıklama, girişten önce içeridekilerden yakınlık ve kabul işareti bulmayı öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Giriş öncesi davranış iki yönden açıklanır: selam verip açıkça izin istemek ve girebilir miyim diye sormak ya da içeridekilerden girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmak. Her iki açıklama da eve izinsiz girmeme sınırında birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: girişten önce izin ve kabul arama
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eve girmeden önce selam, izin sorusu veya içeridekilerin kabulünü yoklama yoluyla girişe onay arandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Giriş öncesi zaman sınırını, izin istemeyi ve kabul bulmayı birlikte korur.
